description:
Player view control. Camera moves keep the player in control: a flying pawn is moved directly, a walking pawn switches
to fly mode first (WASD/QE + mouse), and without any pawn a locked tool camera is used.
Workflow: get_camera -> set_camera (location + look_at) or frame_nodes (fit nodes on screen) -> orbit to circle around ->
reset_camera to give the view back. set_fly_mode / set_fly_speed tune free flight; possess switches pawns;
set_view_mode changes the render mode (lit, unlit, wireframe, ...). All moves are undoable.
name: camera

tools.description:
Points the view so all targets fit on screen. Undoable.
Returns: The new view, with center and distance. Fails if targets is empty, a target is not found, or the targets have no bounds.

direction.description: View direction [x, y, z] (default: the current one), e.g. [1, 0.5, -0.3]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

fov.description: Field of view in degrees for the framing (default: current).

targets.description: Nodes or actors to frame, e.g. ["n3", "n7"].

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: camera.frame_nodes

returnValue.description: The new view, with center and distance. Fails if targets is empty, a target is not found, or the targets have no bounds.

controls.description: What the player can do now.

distance.description: frame_nodes / orbit: distance from the view to the center in cm.

fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

pawn.description: The player's pawn, empty if none.

tool_camera.description: Whether the tool camera is the view target.

returnValue.title: RuntimeCameraView

Reads the current player view.

tools.description:
Orbits the view around a node's bounds centre or a point, by yaw/pitch degrees. Undoable.
Returns: The new view, with center and distance. Fails if neither target nor center is given.

center.description: Or around this point [x, y, z]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

pitch.description: Degrees up (+) or down (-); clamped to +-89.

target.description: Orbit around this node or actor, e.g. "n3". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

yaw.description: Degrees around the vertical axis, e.g. 90.

tools.name: camera.orbit

returnValue.description: The new view, with center and distance. Fails if neither target nor center is given.

tools.description:
Makes the local player control a pawn. Undoable (returns to the previous pawn).
Returns: The possessed pawn and the previous one. Fails if the target is not a pawn or is controlled by another controller.

target.description: The pawn, e.g. "n5". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: camera.possess

returnValue.description: The possessed pawn and the previous one. Fails if the target is not a pawn or is controlled by another controller.

previous.description: The pawn controlled before (empty if none); undo returns to it.

returnValue.title: RuntimePossessInfo

tools.description:
Gives the view back to the player's pawn (or controller) and leaves fly mode. Undoable.
Returns: The view after the reset. Fails if there is no local player.
tools.name: camera.reset_camera

returnValue.description: The view after the reset. Fails if there is no local player.

fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

pawn.description: The player's pawn, empty if none.

tool_camera.description: Whether the tool camera is the view target.

returnValue.title: RuntimeCameraView

tools.description:
Moves the player's view to a pose; parts left out keep the current view. Undoable.
Returns: The new view. Fails if there is no local player or look_at equals the location.

fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees (5-170), e.g. 60.

location.description: View position [x, y, z] in cm, e.g. [0, -1000, 500]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

look_at.description: Point to look at [x, y, z], e.g. [0, 0, 0]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

rotation.description: View rotation [pitch, yaw, roll]; ignored when look_at is given. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

tools.name: camera.set_camera

returnValue.description: The new view. Fails if there is no local player or look_at equals the location.

controls.description: What the player can do now.

fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

tools.description:
Lets the player fly freely from the current view (WASD/QE + mouse), or returns them to their pawn. Undoable.
Returns: Whether fly mode is on and the controls. Fails if there is no local player.

enabled.description: true = fly mode on, false = back to the player's pawn.

tools.name: camera.set_fly_mode

returnValue.description: Whether fly mode is on and the controls. Fails if there is no local player.
returnValue.title: RuntimeFlyModeInfo

tools.description:
Fly speed: auto (scales with distance to the nearest surface) or fixed. Arguments left out keep their value.
Returns: The settings after the change and the current speed. Fails if a speed or multiplier is not positive.

mode.description: Auto, Fixed or Unchanged (giving only `speed` switches to Fixed).

tools.name: camera.set_fly_speed

returnValue.description: The settings after the change and the current speed. Fails if a speed or multiplier is not positive.
returnValue.title: RuntimeFlySpeedInfo

tools.description:
Changes the field of view, keeping the current pose. Undoable.
Returns: The new view. Fails if fov is outside 5-170 or there is no local player.

fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees (5-170), e.g. 50.

tools.name: camera.set_fov

returnValue.description: The new view. Fails if fov is outside 5-170 or there is no local player.

returnValue.title: RuntimeCameraView

tools.description:
Sets the viewport render mode. Undoable.
Returns: The new and the previous mode. Fails if there is no game viewport, or (Unsupported) the mode was stripped from this cooked build.

mode.description: Lit, Unlit, Wireframe, LightingOnly, Reflections, ShaderComplexity, CollisionVisibility, CollisionPawn, LodColoration.

tools.name: camera.set_view_mode

returnValue.description: The new and the previous mode. Fails if there is no game viewport, or (Unsupported) the mode was stripped from this cooked build.

previous.description: The mode before; undo restores it.

returnValue.title: RuntimeViewModeInfo
